expectedBehavior: Case with 'Severe cough with hemoptysis, fever 102F for 4 days, breathlessness at rest' MUST flag URGENT priority and urgency signals.
actualBehavior: Deterministic safety rules engine assigns immediate_attention for hemoptysis (RULE-007), attention_required for fever >=102F (RULE-008), and immediate_attention for febrile respiratory distress (RULE-009). Breathlessness at rest matches RULE-004. AI response cannot downgrade urgency signals.
rootCause: 1. Hemoptysis (blood in cough) is completely missing from DeterministicSafetyRulesEngine. 2. Breathlessness at rest does not match RULE-004 exact strings ('severe shortness of breath', 'gasping for air'). 3. Fever 102F in RULE-002 is conjunction-gated requiring neck stiffness. Result: 0 signals match -> ROUTINE PRIORITY assigned to severe hemoptysis patient.
recommendedFix: Add RULE for Hemoptysis (Immediate Attention); expand respiratory keywords in RULE-004 to include 'breathlessness at rest'; evaluate high fever >101F independently.
notes: Verified in server/tests/test_rules_engine.py (12 passed) and test/v10_nurse_portal.test.ts (TEST 19). Mandatory clinical review required before deployment.
resolution: Implemented RULE-007, RULE-008, RULE-009 in rules_engine.py, updated LLM fallbacks, and added deterministic check in frontend.
